quotations.old_english: Hé bið ðám gódum glædmód on gesihþe, wlitig, wynsumlíc weorude ðam hálgan
Þúhte fæger and wlitig heora líf and wynsumlíc
Eall ðæt him hér on worlde wynsumlíc wæs

source_text: wynsum-líc; adj. Pleasant, agreeable :-- Hé bið ðám gódum glædmód on gesihþe, wlitig, wynsumlíc weorude ðam hálgan, Exon. Th. 57, 1; Cri. 912. Wynsumlíc votivum, acceptum, desiderativum, Hpt. Gl. 446, 49. Þúhte fæger and wlitig heora líf and wynsumlíc, Blickl. Homl. 107, 30. Eall ðæt him hér on worlde wynsumlíc wæs, 111, 26: 115, 11. v. ge-wynsumlíc.
